title: Edge Text To Speech Settings (Try this! Should work for all users. Better than Windows TTS!)
Use Edge Text To Speech
desc: Enable use of Edge TTS as your main EDCoPilot voice

title: Edge Language Code
desc: Step 1: Select the language code from which you will pick voices.

title: Edge Locale
desc: Step 2: Select the locale (accent) from which you will pick voices.

title: Edge Voice Name
desc: Step 3: Select the Edge voice to be used

title: Edge Voice Rate
desc: Change the speed of your copilot voice, as a percentage relative to its default rate (range: 50 to 200)

title: Edge Voice Pitch
desc: Change the pitch of your copilot voice, in Hz (range: -50 to 50)
